description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Proteus Machine.
When Proteus Machine dies, Yedora triggers, returning Proteus Machine to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting the creature card into your hand.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
